resolution: To reset your password, visit the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page. Enter your registered email, and a reset link will be sent to you. If you don't receive it within 5 minutes, please check your spam folder.

Refunds are processed within 7-10 business days. To track your refund, log into our portal and visit the 'Transaction History' section. If you are requesting a NEW refund, please ensure you have your invoice number ready for the finance team.

Books can be issued for up to 14 days. You can renew books twice via the online library catalog. Please ensure you have your physical library card for in-person pickups. Late returns incur a fine of $0.50 per day.

Bus passes are issued at the Transport Office (Block B, Ground Floor). You will need one passport-sized photo and your student/employee ID. Shuttle routes and schedules are available live on our mobile app under the 'Commute' tab.

Exam results and report cards are released via the Academic Portal 15 days after the final exam. For transcripts, please submit a request form at the Academic Office window or via the 'Documents' section online.
